fusions.name: Quarry Throw
fusions.desc: Tears a boulder from the ground and hurls it at a target up to 8 tiles away. It deals 28 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full range. Bosses and elites take a further 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Fault Stomp
fusions.desc: Stamps hard enough to crack the ground. It deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stuns each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Granite Rampart
fusions.desc: Wrenches a slab of bedrock upright ahead of you, 5 tiles long, for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Bedrock Footing
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you have 8% earth resistance.
